Alchemist.3|Experimental Elixir: After a long rest, make one random elixir (more at higher levels); spend a spell slot to make extra ones and pick their effect. Unused elixirs fade at your next long rest.
Alchemist.9|Restorative Reagents: Drinking your elixirs also grants temporary hit points. Cast lesser restoration without a slot a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier per long rest.

Arcane Archer.7|Curving Shot: When you miss with a magic arrow, use a bonus action to reroll the attack against a different target within 60 ft of the first.

Arcane Trickster.17|Spell Thief: Reaction when a spell targets you: the caster must save or the spell fails against you and you can cast it for 8 hours while they can't. Once per long rest.

Armorer.15|Perfected Armor: Guardian: reaction to pull a creature within 30 ft up to 25 ft toward you (Str save) and attack it, Int mod times per long rest. Infiltrator: targets your launcher hits glow; the next attack on them has advantage and +1d6 lightning.

Artillerist.3|Eldritch Cannon: Action: build a Small or Tiny cannon (flamethrower, force ballista, or protector) for 1 hour; bonus action to fire it. Once per long rest free, or spend a spell slot.

Banneret.15|Bulwark: When you use Indomitable to reroll a failed Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma save, one ally within 60 ft who failed against the same effect can reroll too.

Battle Master.3|Combat Superiority: Learn three maneuvers and gain four d8 superiority dice (regained on a short or long rest). Spend a die to fuel a maneuver; what the die adds depends on the maneuver.

Battle Smith.9|Arcane Jolt: Once per turn when your magic weapon or defender hits, deal 2d6 extra force damage or heal a creature within 30 ft of the target for 2d6. Usable Int mod times per long rest.

Beast Master.3|Ranger's Companion: Gain a Medium or smaller beast companion (CR 1/4 or lower). It acts on your turn; you must use your action to command it to attack, otherwise it takes the Dodge action.

Bladesinging.2|Bladesong: Bonus action, 1 minute, no medium/heavy armor or shield: add Intelligence to AC and concentration saves, +10 ft speed, advantage on Acrobatics. Uses equal to proficiency bonus per long rest.
Bladesinging.10|Song of Defense: While Bladesong is active, use your reaction and a spell slot to reduce damage you take by 5 times the slot level.
Bladesinging.14|Song of Victory: After you use your action to cast a spell, make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

Cavalier.3|Unwavering Mark: Hitting a creature marks it until your next turn; while within 5 ft of you it has disadvantage attacking others. If it damages someone else, make a bonus-action punishing attack (Strength mod times per long rest).
Cavalier.7|Warding Maneuver: Reaction when you or a creature within 5 ft is hit: add 1d8 to its AC against that attack; if it still hits, the damage is halved. Uses equal to Constitution modifier per long rest.

Chronurgy Magic.6|Momentary Stasis: Action: a Large or smaller creature within 60 ft that fails a Con save is incapacitated with speed 0 until the end of your next turn. Int mod times per long rest.

Circle of Dreams.10|Hidden Paths: Bonus action: teleport yourself up to 60 ft, or use an action to teleport a willing creature you touch up to 30 ft. Uses equal to Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Circle of Wildfire.10|Cauterizing Flames: When a creature dies near you or your spirit, a flame lingers for a minute; when someone enters it, use your reaction to heal or burn them. Uses equal to proficiency bonus per long rest.
Circle of Wildfire.14|Blazing Revival: When you drop to 0 HP with your spirit nearby, sacrifice it to regain half your hit points and stand up. Once per long rest.

Circle of the Shepherd.2|Spirit Totem: Bonus action: summon a spirit with a 30 ft aura for 1 minute, once per short or long rest (Bear: temp HP and Strength advantage; Hawk: reaction to grant attack advantage; Unicorn: bonus healing and detection).

Clockwork Soul.1|Restore Balance: Reaction: stop a creature within 60 ft from rolling with advantage or disadvantage on a d20. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.
Clockwork Soul.14|Trance of Order: Bonus action, for 1 minute: attacks against you can't have advantage, and your d20 rolls of 9 or lower count as 10. Once per long rest, or again for 5 sorcery points.

College of Creation.3|Performance of Creation: Action: conjure a nonmagical item of limited value and size that lasts hours equal to your proficiency bonus. Once per long rest, or spend a 2nd-level or higher slot.
College of Creation.6|Animating Performance: Action: animate a Large or smaller nonmagical object into a dancing construct for 1 hour; command it with your bonus action. Once per long rest, or spend a 3rd-level or higher slot.

College of Eloquence.3|Unsettling Words: Bonus action: spend a Bardic Inspiration die on a creature within 60 ft; it subtracts the roll from its next saving throw before your next turn starts.
College of Eloquence.6|Universal Speech: Action: up to Cha mod creatures within 60 ft understand you, whatever language you speak, for 1 hour. Once per long rest, or again by spending a spell slot.
College of Eloquence.14|Infectious Inspiration: When a creature within 60 ft succeeds using your Inspiration die, use your reaction to give another creature a free Inspiration die. Cha mod times per long rest.

College of Glamour.3|Mantle of Inspiration: Bonus action, spend a Bardic Inspiration die: a few creatures within 60 ft gain temporary hit points and can each use their reaction to move without provoking opportunity attacks.
College of Glamour.3|Enthralling Performance: After a 1-minute performance, a few humanoids who watched must pass a Wisdom save or be charmed for an hour and admire you. Once per short or long rest.
College of Glamour.14|Unbreakable Majesty: Bonus action, 1 minute: the first time each turn a creature attacks you, it must pass a Charisma save or pick a new target. Once per short or long rest.

College of Whispers.14|Shadow Lore: Action: a creature within 30 ft must pass a Wisdom save or believe you know its darkest secret; charmed for 8 hours, it obeys you but won't fight or risk its life. Once per long rest.

Drakewarden.7|Bond of Fang and Scale: The drake grows to Medium, gains a flying speed, and its bite deals extra damage. You can ride it, but it can't fly while you're riding (until 15th level).
Drakewarden.11|Drake's Breath: Action: you or the drake exhale a 30 ft cone of elemental damage (Dexterity save). Once per long rest, or spend a 3rd-level or higher slot.

Echo Knight.10|Shadow Martyr: Reaction: teleport your echo next to an ally who is being attacked, and the attack targets the echo instead. Once per short or long rest.

Fey Wanderer.7|Beguiling Twist: Advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened. When you or a creature within 120 ft succeeds on such a save, use your reaction to try to charm or frighten another creature (Wis save) for 1 minute.
Fey Wanderer.11|Fey Reinforcements: You always know summon fey and can cast it once per long rest without a slot or material component; you may drop concentration, but then it lasts only 1 minute.

Forge Domain.2|Channel Divinity: Artisan's Blessing: Hour-long ritual to craft a metal item worth up to 100 gp; you must use up metal of equal value.

Graviturgy Magic.6|Gravity Well: When you cast a spell on a creature, you can move it 5 ft if it's willing, you hit it with a spell attack, or it fails the spell's save.
Graviturgy Magic.10|Violent Attraction: Reaction: add 1d10 to a weapon hit, or 2d10 to falling damage, for a creature within 60 ft. Uses equal to Intelligence modifier per long rest.
Graviturgy Magic.14|Event Horizon: Action, concentration up to 1 minute: a 30 ft aura where enemies take force damage and are stopped or slowed (Strength save). Once per long rest, or spend a 3rd-level or higher slot.

Horizon Walker.3|Planar Warrior: Bonus action: choose a creature within 30 ft. Your next weapon hit on it this turn deals all force damage plus 1d8 force (2d8 at 11th level).

Lunar Sorcery.1|Lunar Embodiment: You always know the spells of all three phases (Full, New, Crescent Moon). Pick a phase after a long rest; once per long rest, cast that phase's 1st-level spell without a slot.
Lunar Sorcery.1|Moon Fire: Learn sacred flame; when you cast it you can target two creatures within 5 ft of each other instead of one.
Lunar Sorcery.6|Lunar Boons: When you cast a spell of the schools tied to your current phase, metamagic on it costs 1 fewer sorcery point. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.
Lunar Sorcery.6|Waxing and Waning: Bonus action: spend 1 sorcery point to switch to a different lunar phase.

Monster Slayer.11|Magic-User's Nemesis: Reaction: a creature within 60 ft casting a spell or teleporting must pass a Wisdom save or it fails. Once per short or long rest.
Monster Slayer.15|Slayer's Counter: Reaction when your prey forces you to save: make one weapon attack against it; on a hit, you automatically succeed on the save.

Oath of Glory.15|Glorious Defense: Reaction when you or a creature within 10 ft is hit: add your Charisma modifier to its AC; if the attack misses, you can attack the attacker. Charisma mod uses per long rest.
Oath of Glory.20|Living Legend: Bonus action, 1 minute: advantage on Charisma checks, turn a missed weapon attack into a hit once per turn, and reroll failed saves as a reaction. Once per long rest or spend a 5th-level slot.

Oath of Redemption.20|Emissary of Redemption: Resistance to damage from other creatures, and creatures that hit you take radiant damage equal to half the damage you take. You lose this against a creature you attack or harm until a long rest.

Oath of Vengeance.20|Avenging Angel: Action, 1 hour: grow wings to fly, and emit a 30 ft aura that can frighten enemies. Once per long rest.

Oath of the Crown.3|Channel Divinity: Champion Challenge: Bonus action: creatures of your choice within 30 ft must pass a Wisdom save or be unable to willingly move more than 30 ft away from you.
Oath of the Crown.20|Exalted Champion: Action, 1 hour: resist nonmagical weapon damage, and give allies advantage on death saves and you and allies advantage on Wisdom saves. Once per long rest.

Oath of the Watchers.15|Vigilant Rebuke: Reaction: when you or a creature within 30 ft succeeds on an Int, Wis, or Cha save, deal 2d8 + Cha mod force damage to whoever forced the save.

Oathbreaker.20|Dread Lord: Action, 1 minute: an aura of gloom damages frightened enemies, hides you and allies in shadow, and lets you attack with shadows as a bonus action. Once per long rest.

Order of Scribes.2|Awakened Spellbook: When casting with a slot, swap the damage type for another type found in a same-level spell in your book. Once per long rest, cast a ritual at normal speed.
Order of Scribes.10|Master Scrivener: After a long rest, create a scroll of a 1st- or 2nd-level spell from your book, cast one level higher; it fades at your next long rest.
Order of Scribes.14|One with the Word: Reaction: prevent all damage you take; your book then loses spells (3d6 total levels) for 1d6 long rests. Once per long rest.

Path of Wild Magic.6|Bolstering Magic: Action: touch a creature to give it +1d3 on attacks and checks for 10 minutes, or let it regain a spell slot of level 1d3. Uses equal to proficiency bonus per long rest.
Path of Wild Magic.10|Unstable Backlash: When you take damage or fail a save while raging, use your reaction to roll a new Wild Surge effect, replacing the current one.

Path of the Beast.10|Infectious Fury: When you hit with a natural weapon, force a Wisdom save: on a failure the target uses its reaction to attack a creature you choose, or takes 2d12 psychic. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.
Path of the Beast.14|Call the Hunt: When you rage, choose up to Con mod allies within 30 ft: each deals +1d6 damage once per turn during the rage, and you gain 5 temp HP per ally. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

Path of the Giant.3|Giant's Havoc: While raging, your reach grows by 5 ft and you become Large if smaller. Thrown weapon attacks using Strength add your Rage damage bonus.
Path of the Giant.10|Mighty Impel: Bonus action while raging: move a Medium or smaller creature within reach to a space up to 30 ft away (Strength save if unwilling). It may fall and take damage.

Path of the Storm Herald.14|Raging Storm: Sea: when you hit a creature in your aura with an attack, use your reaction to force a Strength save; on a failure it is knocked prone.

Path of the Totem Warrior.6|Aspect of the Beast: A permanent perk matching the totem (Bear: double carrying capacity and advantage on Strength checks to push, pull, lift, or break; Eagle: see clearly up to a mile; Wolf: track fast, travel stealthily at normal pace).
Path of the Totem Warrior.14|Totemic Attunement: A stronger rage benefit (Bear: hostile creatures next to you have disadvantage attacking others; Eagle: fly while raging but you fall if you end your turn airborne; Wolf: bonus action to knock a Large-or-smaller creature you hit prone).

Path of the Zealot.3|Warrior of the Gods: If a spell would bring you back to life (not as undead), its caster needs no material components for it.
Path of the Zealot.10|Zealous Presence: Bonus action: up to ten creatures within 60 ft that can hear you gain advantage on attack rolls and saves until the start of your next turn. Once per long rest.

Peace Domain.1|Emboldening Bond: Action: bond up to proficiency bonus creatures for 10 minutes; once per turn, a bonded creature near another can add a d4 to an attack, check, or save. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

Phantom.3|Whispers of the Dead: Gain one skill or tool proficiency of your choice; after a short or long rest you can swap it for a different one.
Phantom.3|Wails from the Grave: After a Sneak Attack, a second creature within 30 ft takes necrotic damage from half your Sneak Attack dice. Uses equal to proficiency bonus per long rest.
Phantom.13|Ghost Walk: Bonus action, 10 minutes: hover with a 10 ft fly speed, attacks against you have disadvantage, and you can pass through objects. Once per long rest or destroy a soul trinket.

Psi Warrior.15|Bulwark of Force: Bonus action: you and up to Int mod creatures within 30 ft gain half cover for 1 minute. Once per long rest, or again by spending a psionic die.
Psi Warrior.18|Telekinetic Master: Cast telekinesis without a slot once per long rest (or by spending a psionic die); while concentrating on it, make one weapon attack as a bonus action each turn.

Rune Knight.3|Giant's Might: Bonus action, 1 minute: become Large, gain advantage on Strength checks and saves, and deal extra weapon damage once per turn. Uses equal to proficiency bonus per long rest.
Rune Knight.7|Runic Shield: Reaction when a creature you can see within 60 ft is hit: force the attacker to reroll. Uses equal to proficiency bonus per long rest.

Samurai.18|Strength Before Death: When reduced to 0 HP but not killed, use your reaction to delay falling unconscious and take an extra turn immediately. Once per long rest.

School of Conjuration (Wizard).6|Benign Transposition: Action: teleport up to 30 ft, or swap places with a willing Small or Medium creature. Usable again after a long rest or casting a conjuration spell.

School of Illusion (Wizard).10|Illusory Self: Reaction: an illusory duplicate makes one attack against you automatically miss. Once per short or long rest.

Soulknife.13|Psychic Veil: Action: turn invisible for up to an hour; it ends early if you deal damage or force a save. Once per long rest, or spend a Psionic die.
Soulknife.17|Rend Mind: When you Sneak Attack with a psychic blade, the target must pass a Wisdom save or be stunned for up to a minute. Once per long rest, or spend 3 Psionic dice.

Swarmkeeper.7|Writhing Tide: Bonus action: gain a 10 ft flying speed and can hover for 1 minute. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.
Swarmkeeper.15|Swarming Dispersal: Reaction when you take damage: gain resistance to it and teleport up to 30 ft. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

Tempest Domain.1|Wrath of the Storm: Reaction when a creature within 5 ft hits you: it takes 2d8 lightning or thunder damage (half on a Dexterity save). Uses equal to Wisdom modifier per long rest.

The Archfey (Patron).1|Fey Presence: Action: creatures in a 10 ft cube from you must pass a Wisdom save or be charmed or frightened until your next turn ends. Once per short or long rest.
The Archfey (Patron).6|Misty Escape: Reaction when damaged: teleport 60 ft and turn invisible until your next turn (ends if you attack or cast). Once per short or long rest.

The Fathomless (Patron).10|Grasping Tentacles: Always have Evard's black tentacles and cast it free once per long rest. Casting it gives you temp HP, and damage can't break your concentration on it.

The Genie (Patron).6|Elemental Gift: Resistance to your genie's damage type. Bonus action: gain a 30 ft flying speed for 10 minutes, proficiency bonus times per long rest.
The Genie (Patron).14|Limited Wish: Action: cast any spell of 6th level or lower with a 1-action casting time, from any class list, without components. After use, you can't do it again until you finish 1d4 long rests.

The Great Old One (Patron).6|Entropic Ward: Reaction: impose disadvantage on an attack against you; if it misses, gain advantage on your next attack against it. Once per short or long rest.
The Great Old One (Patron).14|Create Thrall: Action: charm an incapacitated humanoid you touch until the curse is removed or you make a new thrall; you can talk to it telepathically.

The Hexblade (Patron).1|Hexblade's Curse: Bonus action: curse a creature within 30 ft for 1 minute: +prof bonus damage, crits on 19-20, and you heal when it dies. Once per short or long rest.
The Hexblade (Patron).1|Hex Warrior: Medium armor, shields, and martial weapons. After a long rest, pick one one-handed weapon (or your pact weapon) to attack with using Charisma.
The Hexblade (Patron).10|Armor of Hexes: When the target of your Hexblade's Curse hits you, use your reaction to roll a d6; on a 4 or higher the attack misses.
The Hexblade (Patron)._ds: A pact with a mysterious entity from the Shadowfell that speaks through sentient magic weapons. (Xanathar's Guide to Everything)

The Undead (Patron).1|Form of Dread: Bonus action, 1 minute: gain temporary hit points, immunity to fear, and a hit that can frighten once per turn. Uses equal to proficiency bonus per long rest.
The Undead (Patron).6|Grave Touched: You don't need to eat, drink, or breathe. Once per turn change a hit's damage to necrotic; in Form of Dread, also add one extra damage die.
The Undead (Patron).10|Necrotic Husk: Necrotic resistance (immunity in Form of Dread). Once per long rest, when dropped to 0 HP, drop to 1 instead and burst in necrotic energy, gaining a level of exhaustion.

The Undying (Patron).6|Defy Death: When you succeed on a death save or stabilize someone with spare the dying, regain 1d8 + Con mod hit points. Once per long rest.
The Undying (Patron).14|Indestructible Life: Bonus action: regain 1d8 + warlock level hit points and reattach a severed body part. Once per short or long rest.

Trickery Domain.6|Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows: Action: become invisible until the end of your next turn, or until you attack or cast a spell.

Way of the Ascendant Dragon.3|Draconic Disciple: Change unarmed strike damage to an element; learn Draconic. Once per long rest, use your reaction to reroll a failed Intimidation or Persuasion check.
Way of the Ascendant Dragon.3|Breath of the Dragon: Replace an attack with an elemental breath (cone or line, Dexterity save). Uses equal to proficiency bonus per long rest, or spend 2 ki.
Way of the Ascendant Dragon.17|Ascendant Aspect: Breath of the Dragon grows stronger, you gain 10 ft blindsight, and activating Aspect of the Wyrm also blasts nearby creatures with elemental damage.

Way of the Astral Self.3|Arms of the Astral Self: Bonus action, 1 ki: spectral arms for 10 minutes that hit nearby foes on arrival, give +5 ft reach, use Wisdom for unarmed strikes, and let you use Wisdom for Strength checks and saves.
Way of the Astral Self.6|Visage of the Astral Self: Bonus action, 1 ki: an astral face for 10 minutes giving 120 ft darkvision (even in magical darkness), advantage on Insight and Intimidation, and a voice you can whisper to one creature or project 600 ft.
Way of the Astral Self.11|Body of the Astral Self: With both arms and visage active: use your reaction to reduce acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, or thunder damage by 1d10 + Wis, and once per turn add a martial arts die to an astral arm hit.

Way of the Drunken Master.6|Tipsy Sway: Spend 1 ki as a reaction when a creature misses you in melee to make the attack hit another creature within 5 ft of you. Standing up from prone costs only 5 ft.
